name: Chang Jia M&E Engineering Corp.
summary: Chang Jia M&E Engineering Corp., established in Taipei, Taiwan in 1982, is a prominent firm specializing in comprehensive mechanical and electrical (M&E) engineering solutions. The company offers end-to-end services, encompassing planning, design, and contracting for M&E systems within a diverse range of commercial buildings and industrial facilities. Its extensive portfolio includes project construction management for essential infrastructure like water supply, drainage, and sewage systems, as well as sophisticated power generation and distribution. This covers everything from power plants and steam-electricity symbiosis systems to ultra-high, high, and low voltage electrical transmission. Chang Jia also implements integrated security solutions, such as access control, parking fee management, and advanced building automation systems. Fire safety is another key area, with expertise in fire alarm and smoke exhaust system engineering. Specialized mechanical and electrical services are provided for critical environments like electronic semiconductor factories and clean rooms. Furthermore, the company delivers solutions for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), including refrigeration, exhaust, and central monitoring energy management systems. It also undertakes the planning and construction management of intricate mechanical and electrical systems for high-rise developments. Beyond installation, Chang Jia provides detailed design, system planning, and construction supervision services, alongside offering communications and broadcasting solutions. A significant strength lies in its mechanical and electrical system integration capabilities, seamlessly combining various technical disciplines. These include civil engineering, structural design, general electricity, weak current systems, instrumentation and control, fire protection, water supply, drainage, air conditioning and cooling, monitoring, and clean room technologies. In addition to its core engineering work, Chang Jia M&E Corp. diversifies its operations by managing sports centers and basketball stadiums, and by engaging in import and export activities.
